```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list=ls())
data<-read.delim("file_name.txt",h=T,sep="\t",na.strings = "NA", stringsAsFactors=T)


attach(data)
library(rstatix)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

```

```{r}
# ACTION - SELECTION : COURTSHIP INDEX - SUMMARY OF THE DATA & STATS - 
```

```{r}
#  summary of the data - COURTSHIP INDEX (CI)
```

```{r summary data, echo=FALSE, paged.print=TRUE}
a<-summary(CI[which(threat_status=='NT' & comp_status=='alone')])
b<-length(CI[which(threat_status=='NT' & comp_status=='alone')])
data1<-matrix(c(a,b))
colnames(data1)<-'alone_nothreat'
rownames(data1)<-c(names(a), 'sample_size')

c<-summary(CI[which(threat_status=='NT' & comp_status=='competitor')])
d<-length(CI[which(threat_status=='NT' & comp_status=='competitor')])
data2<-matrix(c(c,d))
colnames(data2)<-'compet_nothreat'

g<-summary(CI[which(threat_status=='ET' & comp_status=='alone')])
h<-length(CI[which(threat_status=='ET' & comp_status=='alone')])
data4<-matrix(c(g,h))
colnames(data4)<-'alone_threat'

i<-summary(CI[which(threat_status=='ET' & comp_status=='competitor')])
j<-length(CI[which(threat_status=='ET' & comp_status=='competitor')])
data5<-matrix(c(i,j))
colnames(data5)<-'compet_threat'


alldata<-cbind(data1,data2,data4,data5)
kable(alldata[c(-1,-6),], caption = "Courtship index - summary by threat and competition status")

```


```{r}
res.aov2 <- aov(CI~comp_status*threat_status, data = data)
```

```{r}
plot(res.aov2, 1) #visually check variance 
```

```{r}
plot(res.aov2, 2) #visually check normality  
```

```{r}
a=summary(res.aov2)
a

```

```{r}

b=TukeyHSD(res.aov2)$threat_status
b
```

```{r}
c=TukeyHSD(res.aov2)$comp_status
c
```

```{r}
d=TukeyHSD(res.aov2)$`comp_status:threat_status`
d
```
